title: jobcrawl work item (work-item/v1)
description: One unit of distributed work (crawl a board, enrich or embed a posting, extract skills). Idempotent by key; a newer version supersedes a waiting one. Delivered at least once under a lease (visibility timeout, heartbeat, retry with backoff, dead letter).

key.description: board id (crawl) or content hash / posting id + stage (enrichment)

long.description: expected > 15 min: only workers with a measured smoke for the topic
